responsibility: Umbrella intrinsic header for x86 SIMD and related extensions, aggregating the public MMX, SSE, AVX, AVX-512, SHA, FMA, RTM, GFNI, VAES, VPCLMULQDQ, AMX, prefetch, and keylocker headers into a single include point. It serves as the top-level user API for GCC's x86 vector and accelerator intrinsics, selecting narrower feature headers based on target availability and preprocessing guards.
